XenotypeDef.label: hive progenitor
XenotypeDef.description: A humanoid Hive progenitor — the seed from which the swarm grows. Possessing sentient intelligence and tool-using capability, the progenitor serves as the Overmind's avatar in the physical world. Their skin is tinged green by symbiotic bio-organisms, and their eyes glow with a faint amber hue.
